text:
Sam: Quick sync — SI partners asked for a marketplace canary image schedule for Gaudi and MI300. Need to confirm kernel/driver matrix and avoid firmware windows. Can we align over the next two weeks?
Rachel: SI will also require H100/H200 parity checks — they want the same test harness across vendors. What's our ETA for a trimmed down canary?
Miguel: Kernel/driver baseline I propose: ubuntu-22.04 + 5.15 for Gaudi (Habana stack), ROCm 5.x for MI300, NVIDIA 535 stack for H100/H200. I can post a detailed matrix tomorrow.
Alexa: High-level plan: week 1 = infra smoke + driver sanity; week 2 = SI cert run + regression sweep. Canary image tag: redwood-market-canary-v0.3.
Sam: Rachel, can SI run their integration suite against that tag? Any additional cert items we should bake in?
Rachel: Yes, SI can run it but we need deploy manifests, image checksums, and a quick runbook. Also call out power/thermal tests for B200 variants — they insist on that.
Miguel: I'll add manifests to the build pipeline. Example snippet for SI to use:
```yaml
image: ghcr.io/redwood/redwood-market-canary:v0.3
resources:
  gpumem: 80Gi
  device: b200
```
Sam: DeployBot will publish the build once CI finishes. @DeployBot any ETA on the pipeline?
DeployBot: Build queued (CI #4821). Expected publish 2024-11-14 18:30 UTC :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Alexa: Heads up — partners asked we lock embargo windows for any joint announcement. They require 48–72h notice before external comms.
Rachel: SI requested a dry-run cutover on 2024-11-20 and marketplace canary on 2024-11-21. Can we avoid conflicting infra maintenance?
Miguel: MI300 has a nightly firmware/ROCm update scheduled 2024-11-19 — I'd prefer we avoid that week for the canary.
Sam: Proposal: shift canary to 2024-11-22 00:00 UTC to give a buffer. Action items:
- Miguel: publish driver/kernel compatibility matrix (due 2024-11-10)
- Alexa: draft embargo notice template and stakeholder list (due 2024-11-12)
- Rachel: SI runbook and checklist (due 2024-11-18)
- Sam: coordinate partner comms and draft joint announcement (due 2024-11-20)
Rachel: Two blockers to note: Gaudi training images require a newer libstdc++ than we bundle, and B200 shows an nvlink perf regression patch that's pending vendor signoff.
Alexa: Noted — I'll add both to the risk register and flag owners. @Sam can you confirm?
Sam: Will add to the risk register now. Thanks everyone — keep updates in this thread and ping if anything slips. :thumbsup:
